notes.title: New Game mode and Character Customisations!
notes.content:
Smash Crates has a new game mode and character customisation! 

[h1]Zone Control[/h1]
This new game mode changes up gameplay significantly with players battling it out to place the most number of color blocks within the set time limit. Build as quickly as you can but also make sure to destroy your opponents blocks to achieve victory. If you ever played robbed the nest as a child this game mode will come naturally to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40916044/44524842f0152ccae06e191eabd3a563b308ede6.png[/img]

[h1]Character Customisations[/h1]

We have also added new character customisations! You can now customize your crate with a variety of unlockable hats, eyes and more! Show off your style on the battlefield, even if you don’t win you can still be the most stylish!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40916044/c26f8d7f0ec722ffac870d9e3b67dc61ecf1f9d4.png[/img]

notes.title: Environment Hazards and Team Battle Added!
notes.content:
Hey !
We have just released a new update which includes Team battles, environment hazards and more. 

[h1]Team Mode[/h1]
You can now team up with your friends to see which duo or trio are the cratest of them all.
Simply select the same team in the character selection menu and you are good to Smash. 
Warning: Friendly fire is always on! (insert evil laughter here)

[h1]Environmental Hazards[/h1]
Each map now has its own distinctive environmental hazard. Watch out for Lava explosions, Low Gravity, Updrafts and strong wind gust. 

[h1]Other smaller bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Hit box inconsistencies fixed
[*] Slam + Dash bug fixed
[*] Random item placement improved, items appear even when there is only a small amount of tiles left
[/list]

notes.title: Update 14/10/21
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!
We have been working on some big changes to Smash Crates for the past week but before we get those I wanted to quickly run through what has already been implemented. 
[h1]Completed:[/h1]

[*] Player controllers (movement etc)

As the game currently stands it is completely playable and I have been able to get some great feedback from play testers. 
[h1]Recent Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Mega Crate power up where you increase in size and become a huge destructive machine. 
[*] Added Rocket booster power up, gain the ability of flight and fry your opponents with your rockets flames. 
[*] Built Audio manager to keep track of and control all the games audio components. 
[*] Updated procedural build system to include power up crates, embedded into the environment. 
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40916044/711b55d782c51b1af3b68863bd019c2abbe0d26d.png[/img]

Exciting Stuff! 

See you all next time! 
Fat Alien Cat

notes.title: Welcome to Smash Crates
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome[/h1]
Hey! Welcome to the Smash Crates Dev log. Here I will be adding updates on what is happening with the development of Smash Crates. But first I wanted to talk a little bit about the Fat Alien Cat team. We are a small team of 2 Developers working part-time, my partner is the creative eye behind the art of Fat Alien Cat and I am the programmer/designer. We are both currently working full time in the Australian Visual Effects Industry but have always dreamed of setting up our own game studio, with the goal of creating games we are passionate about and are crazy fun to play. 

Our goal with Smash Crates is to create a unique party game experience where players of all skill levels and partake and enjoy. Taking inspiration from games like “Duck Game” and “Stick Fighters” we aim to create an experience that people can keep coming back to and play with friends locally or online with Steam remote play features. 

You can also follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/FatAlienCat]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/fataliencatgames/]Instagram [/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@fataliencat?lang=en]Tiktok[/url].
